topic: Two siblings inherit their grandmother's house
text: Well, look at this now, the two of them standing there, eyes wide as they take in the old place. Their grandmother's house, standing sturdy and full of memories, has been passed down to them. We all gathered 'round to watch as the papers were signed, the old scroll of land and rights now in their keeping. I can tell, they know the weight of it, the honor of it. They'll make the place thrive, I’m sure. The fields that surround it are good, the soil rich and giving, and they’ve both got the cleverness of their grandmother in them. They’ll work the land well, keep the old ways and the new mixed just right. The saints be praised for watching over them, guiding them into this new chapter.
